annotations.title: Turn automatic top-ups on or off

description:
COSTS MONEY: Turn automatic top-ups on or off

When the minutes or conversations already paid for run low, the amount set here is bought again automatically: from your prepaid euro balance, and when the balance is not enough your stored card is charged (at least 5 euro). Not during a trial. Turning it on needs a default card (see `list_payment_methods`): without one it is refused with 400 and `details.reason` `NO_CARD`; turning it off or changing the amounts always works.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
